author: SerenoV7
short: Check Dead by Daylight queue times.
description: Slash command showing live and PTB queue times (killer and survivor) for every Dead by Daylight region, via deadbyqueue.com.
install_msg: Thanks for installing DeadByQueue! This cog sends requests to the external service api.deadbyqueue.com, stores no data, and needs slash commands enabled: `[p]slash enablecog deadbyqueue` then `[p]slash sync`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any end user data.
